ItemID: NA; Title: haisstronica 160PCS Yellow Heat Shrink Spade Connectors,AWG 12-10 Heat Shrink Spade Terminlas Kit,Male and Female Electrical Quick Disconnect Wire Connectors; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent work centers on mechanical fastening; I don't currently need these wire connectors.
